decks.notes: The main concept of the deck is to ramp up mana quickly using green devotion cards and mana dorks, and then play powerful threats such as Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to draw cards and ramp up mana further. Storm the Festival allows the player to tutor for powerful creatures and Ulvenwald Oddity provides removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and efficient ramp while also utilizing green devotion for additional benefits.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to pressure opponents and control the board. By using the Golgari color combination, the deck can efficiently disrupt opponents' strategies while building a strong board presence. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck. The deck aims to play aggressively and disrupt opponents' game plans, ultimately overwhelming them with its efficient creatures and removal spells. Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a reliable companion that can provide additional value and mana acceleration.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, and Vein Ripper to apply pressure and control the board. With a mixture of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and hand disruption like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing its own aggressive strategy. The inclusion of Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant provides additional versatility and threat potential in combat.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence quickly with low-cost creatures and utilizing cards that provide protection and synergy for the creatures on the battlefield. It looks to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of aggressive threats while also being able to protect its creatures from removal spells and sweepers. The inclusion of cards like Thalia's Lieutenant, Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben help to boost the power and resilience of the deck's small creatures, making them difficult for the opponent to deal with efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap spells and graveyard recursion to consistently bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, and quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck features a mix of card draw spells, removal, and evasion cards to support the strategy, while also incorporating some control elements with counterspells and bounce effects. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and then bring them back to the battlefield to deal damage and close out the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

This deck aims to quickly flood the board with cheap spells and creatures to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays, all while utilizing the Arclight Phoenix to repeatedly deal damage and apply pressure. The deck includes a mix of card draw, removal, and tempo plays to efficiently cycle through the deck and consistently bring back the Phoenix. By maintaining a fast pace and constantly applying pressure, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This Control deck revolves around utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to potentially draw multiple cards and gain card advantage. By incorporating a diverse array of multicolored cards, the deck aims to consistently hit Niv-Mizzet's requirements. The inclusion of cards like Bring to Light, Vanishing Verse, and Leyline Binding further enhances the deck's ability to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The addition of the companion Yorion allows for additional flexibility and value, making this deck a versatile and powerful contender in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap evasive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. By generating card advantage through cards like Curious Obsession and Mausoleum Wanderer, the player aims to gain tempo and overwhelm the opponent with a continual stream of threats. The inclusion of spirits with flash allows for flexibility in deploying threats and protecting important creatures. This deck seeks to maintain control of the board while applying pressure to quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on using artifacts to quickly establish a board presence and deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes efficient artifact creatures like Smuggler's Copter and Voldaren Epicure, along with cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast to turn artifacts into threats. The deck aims to be aggressive and apply pressure early on, utilizing cards like Torch the Tower and Spyglass Siren to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional mana fixing and flexibility.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cheap removal and counterspells. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, using cantrips and card draw to find the pieces needed to enable multiple Phoenix triggers in a turn. The key strategy is to maintain a strong board presence while pressuring the opponent, ultimately overwhelming them with repeated attacks from the flying Phoenixes.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy focused on green devotion. By utilizing cards that generate mana and ramp, as well as powerful green creatures, the deck aims to quickly build up a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Leyline of the Guildpact and Storm the Festival further enhances the deck's ability to establish dominance on the battlefield. Ultimately, this deck is designed to capitalize on green devotion synergies to push for a swift victory in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control finisher, supported by various multicolor cards and versatile spells to control the board and answer threats. With the added flexibility of Bring to Light, the deck aims to consistently draw into answers and threats while generating value through Niv-Mizzet's ability. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional control options, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value and protection. Overall, the deck's key concept revolves around control, card advantage, and powerful multicolor synergies.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay with a variety of creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional flexibility in deck construction. With a mix of efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, alongside powerful spells like Monstrous Rage and Play with Fire, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors for the deck's game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game using a variety of spells and removal cards while ramping up to play powerful multicolor creatures like Niv-Mizzet Reborn and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck includes cards for card advantage like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding, along with removal like Vanishing Verse and Lightning Helix. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up to powerful threats to finish the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper, alongside disruptive spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support and protection for creatures, while Archfiend of the Dross serves as a powerful finisher. The mana base is designed for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to apply relentless pressure and close out games swiftly.

This control deck revolves around utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw cards and gain card advantage while efficiently controlling the board with removal spells and counters. The deck also includes a variety of mana fixing cards to ensure it can consistently cast Niv-Mizzet and other powerful spells from its diverse color requirements. With the addition of Yorion as a companion, the deck gains extra value from blinking permanents for additional card advantage and flexibility in its strategies. By effectively managing resources and out-valuing opponents, this deck aims to dominate the late game and secure victory.
